pullRequests.body: Adds matching C implementations for 52 previously undecompiled PAL resident game functions (9,408 bytes). The batch covers menu state updates, inventory checks, resource lookup and typed dispatch, callback maps, buffered data ranges, command packets, and grouped flag updates. Interfaces were reviewed against retail callers and callees, including forwarded arguments, callback signatures, output pointers, floating-point inputs and returns, and 64-bit packet values. pullRequests.title: Match 50 PAL resident functions
pullRequests.author: Sumaiter
pullRequests.head: decomp/pal-large-batch-06
pullRequests.body:
Adds matching C implementations for 50 previously undecompiled PAL resident functions (9,796 bytes). Cross-game comparison identified public RAC1/RAC2/RAC3 implementations useful for 28 of these reconstructions. Immutable donor commits, paths and functions are credited in config/pal/crossgame_sources.tsv, source comments and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Fingerprints were used to find references; acceptance uses this game's PAL retail code.

pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: claude/rac4-pal-batch-86-89
pullRequests.body:
Merges #86, #87, #88 and #89 together. All four were green on their own but conflict with each other in the generated files, because each regenerated config/*/map.tsv, progress/pal/report.json and the README table. No file under src/ is touched by more than one of them.
Merge this with a merge commit, not a squash: the four PR heads then land on main, and GitHub marks those PRs as merged with their authors' commits intact.
